core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Ferhat corresponds to the Persian form فرهاد (Persian فرهاد < Middle Persian Frahād). Its core sense is renowned, magnificent. The source record labelled Ferhat 'Arabic' and glossed it 'renowned, magnificent' from an alleged Arabic word Farh; that derivation is not supported. Ferhat/Ferhad/Farhad is the Persian name فرهاد (Farhād), from Middle Persian Frahād and Old Iranian fra-hāta- 'merited, obtained', borne by Arsacid kings from c. 170 BC. It is widely used in Turkish and Kurdish as well. The Arabic form given in the source (فرحات) is not the standard form of this name.
